cards.mine: I want to consign one luggage.
cards.note: luggage 不可数，用 bag 更口语

cards.zh: 能给我靠过道的位置吗？
cards.mine: Can I sit beside the walkway?
Is my luggage beyond the weight?

cards.en: Our flight's been [[pushed back]] an hour.
cards.mine: Our flight is late for one hour.
I can't catch my transfer flight.

cards.en: Can you [[rebook me]] on the next flight?
cards.mine: Can you change my ticket to the next flight?

cards.en: My bag [[didn't turn up]] on the carousel.
cards.mine: My luggage didn't come out.

cards.en: Where do I [[report a lost bag]]?
cards.mine: Where can I register my lost luggage?
Can this bring onto the plane?
I already did the online check in.
Our transfer time is very short.
Can you help us upgrade the cabin?
The security check line is very long.

cards.zh: 航班取消了，你们会安排住宿吗？
cards.en: Our flight got cancelled. Will you [[put us up]] somewhere?
cards.mine: Can you arrange a hotel for us?
cards.note: put sb up = 安排住处

us.en: Our flight got canceled. Will you [[put us up]] somewhere?

cards.mine: Can I check in in advance?
Can I delay my check out?

cards.en: The air con in my room [[isn't working]].
cards.mine: The air conditioner is broken down.
cards.note: 设备坏了常说 isn't working

us.en: The AC in my room [[isn't working]].

cards.zh: 隔壁太吵了，能换个房间吗？
cards.en: It's really noisy next door. Could I [[move rooms]]?
cards.mine: Can I change a room?

us.en: It's really noisy next door. Could I [[switch rooms]]?

cards.zh: 能帮我寄存一下行李吗？
cards.en: Could you [[hold my bags]] for a few hours?
cards.mine: Can you keep my luggage for me?

cards.en: How do I [[get to]] the train station?
cards.mine: Where is the way to the train station?
I lost my way.

cards.zh: 所以是一直走，然后左转？
cards.en: So I [[keep going straight]], then turn left?
cards.mine: Walk straight then turn to left?

cards.en: I'd like to [[hire a car]] for three days.
cards.mine: I want to rent a car for three days.
cards.note: 澳洲常说 hire a car

us.en: I'd like to [[rent a car]] for three days.
us.mine: I want to borrow a car for three days.

cards.mine: How much do I pay myself if accident happens?

cards.en: Can I [[drop it off]] at a different location?
cards.mine: Can I return the car in another place?
